transcript.text: Hi everyone. Before I publish the December holiday on-call roster, we need to run through the holiday-readiness process. The draft has Riley as primary on-call and Casey as secondary for December 24, 25, and 26, with a standard 30-minute escalation target. I need SRE, payments engineering, customer support, and security to each read back your coverage and flag any exceptions. Once I've recorded all flagged exceptions, I'll publish the binding roster. Who wants to go first?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag an exception: my approved leave covers December 25, so I cannot be primary or secondary on-call that day. The roster spreadsheet hasn't been updated to reflect this yet.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag an exception on behalf of payments engineering. The payments service's enterprise response agreement requires a named payments engineer to acknowledge a production alert within exactly 10 minutes on all three dates — December 24, 25, and 26 — rather than the draft's 30-minute escalation target. I confirmed this clause with account operations this morning but haven't updated the on-call ticket yet.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a customer support exception: the customer Meridian has a contractual requirement for a support liaison to contact its administrators during any December 26 production incident. I found this in an account-notes review yesterday. The holiday handoff document still has the default unassigned value, but Taylor must be named as the December 26 customer liaison. So for December 26, I need to be assigned as the customer support liaison for any production incident affecting Meridian.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to flag a security exception. A certificate rotation for the production identity service is scheduled for December 26 from 21:00 to 23:00. This requires me, Jordan, as the security escalation contact and secondary on-call during that window. I confirmed the timing during a certificate inventory, but the change ticket has not yet been linked to the holiday roster. So for December 26, 21:00–23:00, I need to be assigned as the security escalation contact and secondary on-call.
transcript.speaker: A5

commitments.detail: Riley is removed from primary and secondary on-call for December 25 due to approved leave (PF1). Riley remains primary on-call for December 24 and December 26, as no exception was flagged for those dates.

Casey is reassigned from secondary to primary on-call for December 25, replacing Riley who is on approved leave (PF1). Casey remains secondary on-call for December 24. For December 26, 21:00–23:00, Casey is superseded as secondary by Jordan due to the certificate rotation requirement (PF4); outside that window Casey remains secondary.

The escalation target for production alerts on the payments service is reduced from 30 minutes to 10 minutes for all three dates (December 24, 25, 26), and a named payments engineer must be available to acknowledge within that window (PF2).
Taylor is assigned as the customer support liaison for any production incident affecting Meridian on December 26 (PF3).
Jordan is assigned as the security escalation contact and secondary on-call for December 26, 21:00–23:00, during the production identity service certificate rotation (PF4).
